name: andrej-karpathy-skills
description: Behavioral coding guidelines inspired by Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.

interface.shortDescription: Coding guidelines that reduce common LLM mistakes.
interface.longDescription: Use these guidelines for coding, debugging, review, and refactoring tasks that need explicit assumptions, simple solutions, surgical edits, and verifiable success criteria.
defaultPrompt: Apply Karpathy guidelines to this coding task.
Review this change for hidden assumptions and overengineering.
Plan the smallest verified fix for this bug.
